domains.name: Interactive Prototype Behavior
domains.scope: Implement and test bounded interaction state models for draft recovery, asynchronous result ownership and transactional edit history.

skills.name: interrupted-form-draft-restoration
skills.description: Implement and test a form-draft recovery model when interrupted editing must resume without overwriting newer work or treating a saved draft as a submitted record.

skills.name: asynchronous-result-generation-ownership
skills.description: Implement and test request-generation ownership when delayed responses must not replace results for a user's newer input.

skills.name: transactional-edit-history-branching
skills.description: Implement and test undo and redo history when multi-step editing must preserve transaction boundaries and discard abandoned redo branches after a new edit.
